source.license: Project-authored synthetic examples, provided for use and modification in this project.
limitations: AI-authored fictional practice data; no real candidates, jobs, or hiring outcomes.
Human approval of these examples does not establish real-world model quality.
Similar templates may leak phrasing across source splits; these are pipeline exercises only.
source.review_limitations: AI approvals authorized by project owner; no human-reviewed attestation. Small templated fictional data supports pipeline testing only.

label_definitions.Vague: Contains unclear, non-measurable role expectations that need contextual clarification.
label_definitions.Biased: Contains an explicit potentially exclusionary age, gender, or language restriction requiring contextual review.
label_definitions.Experience_Inflated: Contains an experience expectation that conflicts with the stated entry level or stated technology timeline.
